cities.name: Belgrade
interests: Historic Views & Fortress Walls 🏰 — Kalemegdan, Ottoman–Austro-Hungarian layers and epic river panoramas.
Urban Culture & Creative Streets 🎭 — Skadarlija, Dorćol corners, museums and busy pedestrian zones.
River Walks & Sunset Spots 🌊 — Sava and Danube riverfronts, bridges and chill evening promenades.
cities.local_food_tip: Try Serbian pastries, gibanica, prebranac (baked beans), grilled vegetables, mild soups, kajmak and fresh bread — comforting, homestyle and easy to enjoy even with vegetarian preferences.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Kalemegdan Fortress: Walk the old walls, viewpoints and tucked-away paths. → 🗽 Victor Monument: Iconic statue above the confluence. → 🎖️ Military Museum (exterior): Tanks, cannons and open-air exhibits. → 🛍️ Knez Mihailova Street: Main pedestrian artery with shops and street musicians. → ☕ Republic Square: Café break with views of the National Museum and Theatre. Afternoon: 🎨 Skadarlija: Cobblestone bohemian quarter with murals and galleries. → ⚡ Nikola Tesla Museum: Experiments, coils and science fun. → ⛪ Temple of Saint Sava & plateau: Massive white dome and wide square perfect for photos. → 🍽️ Lunch: Traditional Serbian restaurant or modern bistro with veggie-friendly options (prebranac, grilled veggies, soups). Sunset: 🌅 Gardoš Tower in Zemun: Viewpoint over orange rooftops and the Danube. Night: 🌃 Beton Hala & Savamala riverfront: Chill strolls, dessert places and non-alcoholic drinks with river views.

🌳 Crunchy leaves in Tašmajdan and Kalemegdan Park.
